evidence: The Alternative.me Fear & Greed Index plummeted by 21 points from 51 (Neutral) on October 29 to 30 (Fear) on October 30, breaking significantly below both its 7-day mean (47.86) and 30-day mean (59.40). While deep fear readings can eventually signal contrarian buying opportunities over medium horizons, sharp single-day sentiment collapses typically reflect aggressive selling pressure and risk-off momentum that often carry negative follow-through over a 24-hour horizon. Consequently, the likelihood of a higher close over the next 24 hours is assessed as modestly below even odds.
limitations: Fear & Greed Index is a daily sentiment composite that lags intraday price action and order book dynamics.
Contract tie-breaking rules classify flat performance as down, creating a slight structural headwind for the up outcome.
Snapshot availability and later revisions are caller-attested, not independently verified.
